summary_text:
Strawberry Chair is now open for laps on Dell Valley! The gondola starts loading at 8:30 am, with Strawberry and the Mitey Mite carpet opening at 9:30 am. Enjoy early season turns and the rail park on lower Strawberry while our team works to open more lifts and runs as conditions allow.

Save some energy for a few “laps” at Mad Trappers, open from 10:30 am. Visit our Early Season page for what’s open, operating hours and lift ticket prices.
